appearance.silhouette: 뜯어낸 문짝 방패 뒤로 몸을 숨기고 팔에 낡은 붕대를 감은 산적 방어병
appearance.body: 보통 키지만 두꺼운 몸통과 낮은 무게중심의 성인 방어병 체형.
appearance.face: 거친 수염 자국이 조금 남은 익명 산적 얼굴; 실존 인물의 얼굴이나 초상을 재현하지 않는다.
appearance.costume: 바랜 회청색 작업복 한 벌, 오른쪽 팔뚝의 낡은 붕대 한 묶음.
appearance.equipment: 왼팔에 세로로 든 뜯어낸 좁은 나무 문짝 방패 1개; 방패 바깥면에 흰 눈 모양 먹표식 1개.
appearance.handedness: 왼팔에 문짝 방패 1개, 오른손에 짧은 나무 몽둥이 1개를 낮게 든다.
appearance.palette: 탁한 목재 갈색, 바랜 회청색, 먹검정, 표식의 작은 탁한 회백색.
appearance.materials: 거친 열린 먹선과 저밀도 파스텔·수채 mass; 문짝 나뭇결과 못은 미세 묘사하지 않는다.
appearance.identifyingFeatures: 세로 문짝 방패의 흰 눈 표식 정확히 1개, 오른쪽 팔뚝 붕대, 짧은 몽둥이.

requiredElements: 낮은 무게중심의 성인 방어병 전신을 가리지 않는 near-front 3/4 중립 자세.
왼팔 세로 문짝 방패 정확히 1개, 오른손 짧은 나무 몽둥이 1개.
방패 바깥면 흰 눈 모양 표식 정확히 1개와 오른쪽 팔뚝 붕대.
거칠고 저밀도인 ProjectBS open ink/mok-seon과 넓은 pastel mass.

singleImageSpecification.framing: head-to-toe, no crop, one character only

phases: f0 low barricade ready with vertical door shield on anatomical LEFT arm and club low in RIGHT hand
f1 deep grounded compression behind the shield
f2 short support-foot set and pelvis load without root translation
f3 torso drives the single door shield forward while the club remains controlled
f4 one heavy frontal shield-bash impact with minor knockback read
f5 brief forward hold, no second bash and no club strike
f6 shield retracts as knees absorb force
f7 stable barricade-ready recovery
animationRequests.motion: slow defensive melee shield bash derived from the existing skill; connected foot, knee, pelvis, torso and LEFT-shoulder drive, never an arm-only shove
equipmentLocks: exactly one narrow vertical reclaimed wooden door shield on anatomical LEFT arm
exactly one white eye-shaped ink mark on the shield outer face
exactly one short wooden club in anatomical RIGHT hand
exactly one bandage bundle on anatomical RIGHT forearm
no additional shield, club, door part, weapon, armor, or equipment duplication
animationRequests.styleEffects: short heavy broken black/brown dry-brush pressure attached to the shield edge at f3-f5 and sparse dusty gray-blue/ochre grounded pastel compression; no magic, aura, detached impact object, clean vector burst, or cell crossing

phases: f0 anatomical LEFT contact
f1 LEFT compression
f2 LEFT-to-RIGHT passing
f3 distinct guarded up phase
f4 anatomical RIGHT contact opposite f0
f5 RIGHT compression opposite f1
f6 RIGHT-to-LEFT passing opposite f2
f7 distinct guarded up phase closing into f0
animationRequests.motion: very slow screen-right barricade advance at movement scale 0.5: short heavy steps, low center of gravity, planted push-off and stable shield coverage; game root fixed, no camera pan or shield-first sliding
equipmentLocks: single vertical door shield remains on anatomical LEFT arm with one eye mark outward
single short club remains low in anatomical RIGHT hand
no hand swap, whole-body mirror, duplication, detachment, extra door part, or new equipment
animationRequests.styleEffects: minimal body-attached broken ink pressure under planted steps and tiny shield/clothing lag; no attack burst, detached trail, floor cloud, magic, or neighboring-cell effect

phases: f0 low planted barricade guard
f1 shallow inhale behind shield
f2 small knee and hip weight settle without moving the root
f3 exhale as club hand lowers a fraction
f4 brief screen-right defensive focus while shield stays vertical
f5 shield, sleeve and bandage settle cleanly into f0
animationRequests.motion: restrained living front-defender idle with both feet planted and continuous shield coverage; not an attack wind-up, walking-in-place, or ceremonial display
equipmentLocks: one vertical door shield on anatomical LEFT arm
one white eye mark on shield face
one club in anatomical RIGHT hand
no mirror, hand swap, duplication, disappearance, detachment, or extra equipment
animationRequests.styleEffects: almost none; at most tiny body-attached broken settling marks that vanish by f5; no aura, glow, floor effect, magic, or neighboring fragment

combat.roleIntent: 주민 보호전과 수련장 포위전에서 전열을 막는 저등급 방어 적

notes: cage_guard_bandit보다 이른 시점에 쓰는 가벼운 방어형.
핵앤슬래시 다수 몬스터 전투 기준으로 공격 스코어 50%, 체력 스코어 25% 보정 적용. NPC 기본 회복 스탯은 사용하지 않는다.
